- 完整功能见这里 https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.superhide.viptry/blob/main/%E8%B6%85%E9%9A%90App%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E-%E5%AE%A3%E4%BC%A0.md

使用方法

1. 在 LSPosed 中启用本模块，并重启作用域内的目标应用（必要时重启手机）。
2. 打开「黄金超隐」App，在应用列表里勾选需要模拟的目标应用。
3. 按需配置各项字段、定位或虚拟媒体源；配置保存在设备本地。
4. 部分能力需要注册码 / 权益授权，未授权时对应开关不生效或置灰。

注意事项
- 只勾选自己确实需要模拟的应用，不要把系统核心进程（如 android、com.android.phone）
  加入作用域，避免系统异常。
- 模拟设置仅作用于被勾选的应用进程；卸载模块后配置不会自动恢复。
- 每次发版的说明见本仓库的 Releases 页面。

modules.name: YadeaHook Xposed 模块，用于监控和控制雅迪智行里的电动车。
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: YadeaHook Xposed 模块，用于监控和控制雅迪智行里的电动车。
modules.readme:
YadeaHook

这是一个为 雅迪智行 (com.yadea.smartmoto) 开发的 Android Xposed 模块，支持监控车辆状态、发送控制指令、BLE 设备连接以及超速警报等功能。

功能特性

🚗 车辆状态监控
- 实时数据 — 自动读取电压、电流、电池 SOC、车速、总里程（ODO）、锁车状态等 TtpInfo 字段。
- 数据广播 — 通过 JSON 广播实时输出车辆数据，方便外部应用（如 Widget、桌面组件）对接。
- 多车辆支持 — 支持电动车（PanelInfo/FaultInfo/TtpInfo）和滑板车（ScooterStatusInfo/TtpInfo）两种状态格式。

🎮 车辆控制
- 锁车/解锁 — 远程锁定和解锁滑板车。
- 档位切换 — 支持 SCOOTER_GEAR_1 ~ SCOOTER_GEAR_6 六个档位。
- 巡航控制 — 开启/关闭巡航模式。
- 能量回收 — 三档能量回收等级调节。
- 命令映射 — 自动映射命令类型（如 SCOOTER_LOCK → FORTIFY）。

📡 BLE 连接管理
- 连接状态监控 — 实时监控蓝牙连接过程、断开事件及通知回调。
- 设备扫描 — 扫描附近的 BLE 设备。
- 多协议支持 — 支持滑板车、自行车、网络三种连接方式。
- 认证捕获 — 捕获 BLE 认证序列（INIT/KEY/QUERY 等帧）用于调试。
- 只读全链路抓包 — 覆盖 Android BLE 框架、原 App 五步连接任务、通知注册、命令生成、tl 写入入口、旧握手和 wi 通知解析器；不修改参数、返回值、调用流程或车辆状态。

🚨 超速警报
- 独立开关 — 在设置页一键开启或关闭速度警报。
- 速度监控 — 实时监控车速，超过阈值时触发警报。
- 自定义音频 — 支持自定义警报音频文件。
- 可配置阈值 — 通过 UI 设置速度阈值（默认 25 km/h）。
- 冷却时间 — 防止频繁触发，支持配置冷却时间。

🔐 凭证提取
- BLE Key 捕获 — 捕获雅迪 App 连接车辆时使用的蓝牙认证密钥。
- Device Token 抓取 — 从 OkHttp 响应中提取设备认证令牌。
- 协议分析 — 通过 BleFrameClassifier 精确识别认证帧类型。
- 一键登录抓取 — Hook p46.a/b，提取 loginToken、gyuid 和来源。
- 登录成功抓取 — 捕获 p46$a/p46$b 回调及 UserInfoBean 中的用户和 token。
- 业务 JSON / 网关签名 — Hook f84.b、tb0.d，保存签名前后完整数据。
- 最终请求头 — Hook sb0.intercept 和 Request.Builder.build()，读取真正发出的请求头。
- usr_token — Hook zm3.z0/h2，同时提供带 Bearer  前缀的复制按钮。

📱 设备控制（ DG-LAB 协议）
- 独立开关 — 在设置页或设备页开启，关闭时会停止扫描并断开设备连接。
- BLE 设备连接 — 连接支持 DG-LAB 协议的外部 BLE 设备。
- 强度控制 — 手动或自动调节设备强度（0-200）。
- 速度-强度映射 — 根据车速自动调整设备强度，支持自定义曲线。
- 电池电量读取 — 读取连接设备的电池电量。
- V2/V3 协议 — 支持 DG-LAB 协议 V2 和 V3 版本。

🖥️ 内置仪表盘
- Material3 UI — 基于 Compose 的现代化界面。
- 三页面导航 — Home（日志和数据）、Device（设备控制）、Settings（设置）。
- 功能开关 — 设置页统一控制速度警报和设备控制，修改后立即生效。
- 登录抓取面板 — Home 页可复制 loginToken、gyuid、Bearer token、业务 JSON 和请求头。
- 实时日志 — 显示 Hook 日志和完整的 TtpInfo 数据面板。
- 曲线编辑器 — 可视化编辑速度-强度映射曲线。

环境要求
- 设备: 已 Root 且安装了 LSPosed 的设备，或使用 LSPatch 处理后的环境。
- 系统: Android 9.0 (API 28) 及以上。
- 目标应用: 雅迪智行 (com.yadea.smartmoto)。
- 蓝牙权限: 需要 BLUETOOTH_SCAN、BLUETOOTH_CONNECT、ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION 权限（用于设备控制功能）。

安装步骤

1. 编译或下载模块 APK。
2. 在 LSPosed 管理器中安装并启用模块。
3. 勾选 雅迪智行 作为作用域。
4. 强制停止并重新启动雅迪智行 APP。
5. 授予蓝牙权限（首次使用设备控制功能时）。

广播接口说明

1. 接收车辆状态 (STATUS)
Action: com.ghhccghk.yadeahook.STATUS

// 注册接收器
val filter = IntentFilter("com.ghhccghk.yadeahook.STATUS")
registerReceiver(receiver, filter)

// 在 onReceive 中获取数据
val jsonData = intent.getStringExtra("data")

JSON 示例数据:
{
  "title": "雅迪车辆信息",
  "tag": "更新时间：14:30:25",
  "time": "14:30:25",
  "key1": "电压",
  "value1": "74.3V",
  "key2": "电流",
  "value2": "12.5A",
  "key3": "功率",
  "value3": "928.8W",
  "key4": "电池电量",
  "value4": "85 %",
  "key5": "车速",
  "value5": "25.0km/h",
  "key6": "总里程",
  "value6": "1234.5km",
  "soc": "85",
  "parkingStatus": "0",
  "onOffStatus": "11"
}

2. 手动请求更新 (UPDATE)
Action: com.ghhccghk.yadeahook.UPDATE

sendBroadcast(Intent("com.ghhccghk.yadeahook.UPDATE"))

3. 发送控制命令 (CONTROL)
Action: com.ghhccghk.yadeahook.CONTROL

| 命令 (command) | 额外参数 (param) | 说明 |
|----------------|-----------------|------|
| SCOOTER_LOCK | - | 锁定滑板车 |
| SCOOTER_UNLOCK | - | 解锁滑板车 |
| SCOOTER_GEAR_1 ~ 6 | - | 切换档位 (对应 0-5) |
| SCOOTER_OPEN_CRUISE_CONTROL | - | 开启巡航控制 |
| SCOOTER_CLOSE_CRUISE_CONTROL | - | 关闭巡航控制 |
| SCOOTER_ENERGY_RECOVERY_1 ~ 3 | - | 能量回收等级 (1-3) |
| disconnect | - | 断开蓝牙连接 |
| connect_scooter | mac (String) | 连接指定 MAC 地址的滑板车 |
| connect_bicycle | mac (String) | 连接指定 MAC 地址的自行车 |

sendBroadcast(Intent("com.ghhccghk.yadeahook.CONTROL").apply {
    putExtra("command", "SCOOTER_LOCK")
})

4. 接收速度警报 (SPEED_ALERT)
Action: com.ghhccghk.yadeahook.SPEED_ALERT

val speed = intent.getFloatExtra("speed", 0f)

5. 接收 BLE 认证数据 (AUTH)
Action: com.ghhccghk.yadeahook.AUTH

val initHex = intent.getStringExtra("init")
val keyHex = intent.getStringExtra("key")
val seq = intent.getLongExtra("seq", 0)
val push = intent.getStringExtra("push")
val text = intent.getStringExtra("text")

技术细节

360 加固处理
目标应用使用了 360 加固。本模块通过 Hook com.stub.StubApp.attachBaseContext 来获取解密后的 Context 及其 ClassLoader，从而确保能正常加载目标类。

Hook 架构
MainHook → VehicleServiceLoad.initHooks(context)
  → 进程检查: 只在 com.yadea.smartmoto 主进程初始化
  → 包名检查: 明确拒绝 top.ghhccghk.yadea 移植包
  → BleConnectStateHook.init(classLoader, context)
  → VehicleControlHook.init(classLoader, context)
  → VehicleStatusHook.init(classLoader, context)
  → ScooterStatusHook.init(classLoader, context)
  → VehicleDataReadHook.init(classLoader, context)
  → VehicleServiceOnNotifyDataCallBackHook.init(classLoader, context)
  → BleAuthCaptureHook.init(classLoader, context)       # Android BLE 框架只读抓包
  → YadeaBleBusinessHook.init(classLoader, context)     # 原 App BLE 业务只读抓包
  → CredentialExtractHook.init(classLoader, context)
  → LoginCaptureHook.init(classLoader, context)
  → SpeedAlertHook.init(classLoader, context)

只读 BLE 抓包

先确认目标包名，且不要把作用域勾成移植包：

adb shell pm list packages | Select-String -Pattern "yadea|smartmoto"

当前抓包覆盖：
- Android BLE 框架：connectGatt 全部重载、discoverServices、setCharacteristicNotification、读写 descriptor/characteristic 全部公开重载、GATT callback 全部读写与连接回调、onCharacteristicChanged 新旧重载。
- 实际回调分发：连接时按实际 BluetoothGattCallback 运行时类补装覆写方法，同时匹配 framework 内部 BluetoothGatt$1.onNotify(String,int,byte[])。实际类名或描述符不匹配时只记录 MISSING/ERROR。
- GATT 数据库：onServicesDiscovered 后输出 service、characteristic、descriptor、UUID、properties、writeType 和已有值。
- 原 App 业务链路：BleBicycleConnect.z/v、五步任务开始/完成/失败、BleControlManager.d/s/e、BleBicycleCommandManager 命令生成/字段快照、tl.s0/Q/q0、wi.S/M/Z0、wi$g.f、wi$d.e。
- 握手与状态查询：记录旧握手随机块、wi$g.f 实际握手数据、0x34 状态查询完整 HEX，以及生成前后 increaseByteNum 和全部命令管理字段。

日志统一为 YADEA_CAP 结构化格式，例如：

YADEA_CAP|SEQ=1|PID=1234|TID=5678|thread=Binder:1234_2|BLE|TX|hook=BleAuthCaptureHook|method=...|mac=AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF|runtime=com.yadea.blecontrol...|service=...|uuid=...|props=...|writeType=1|len=37|data=59443E...

byte[] 在进入日志前立即 clone()，统一输出大写连续 HEX。安装阶段的每个候选点都会输出 INSTALLED 或 MISSING；运行期异常输出带 Hook 类名和方法名的 ERROR，不会向原 App 抛出。

本次静态核对结果：
- 已有但仍复用：BleAuthCaptureHook 的认证帧分类、writeCharacteristic、setValue、GATT 写确认、通知和连接状态；VehicleServiceOnNotifyDataCallBackHook 的业务通知对象监控。...

modules.name: MountX
modules.author: Noir
modules.description: Android App & Game Storage Bind-Mount Engine & Advanced I/O Optimization.
modules.readme:
MountX

Move massive Android games to MicroSD or USB storage with zero lag, zero crashes, and zero reinstallation.

Running out of space from 50 GB+ games like *Wuthering Waves*, *Genshin Impact*, or *Honkai: Star Rail*?

MountX safely moves heavy game files to your MicroSD card, external SSD, or USB drive while keeping the phone convinced they are still on internal storage. Your games run at full speed, updates work normally, and your save data is never touched.

Download APK & Module  •  Getting Started  •  Documentation Wiki

      Master Control

      Storage Breakdown

      Apps Manager

      Partition Manager

🎯 What You Get
- Reclaim 30 GB to 80 GB per Game
  Move massive texture packs, audio files, and cutscenes to your external storage and free up your precious internal memory for photos, videos, and daily apps.
- Native Hardware Speed & Zero Lag
  Unlike old moving methods that caused stutter, games load assets directly through native storage channels without performance loss.
- Safe by Design: Zero Risk of Data Loss
  Your login sessions, saved progress, and app databases stay safe on internal storage. Only the heavy, replaceable asset files are moved.
- Automatic Boot Restoration
  Reboot your phone whenever you want. MountX automatically restores all game mounts in the background before you even unlock your screen.
- Beautiful Dark & Light Themes
  Features a high-contrast AMOLED Cyber Dark theme and a soft Sandstone Light theme that adapts to your system setting.

🛠️ Technical Highlights

For power users and developers interested in the implementation:
- Kernel VFS Bind-Mounts: Direct filesystem redirection with global namespace propagation, bypassing user-space FUSE overhead and EXDEV errors.
- Granular Category Offloading: Selectively offload game assets (Android/data), expansion files (Android/obb), or custom folders while keeping SQLite databases in /data/data.
- Integrated Partition Formatter: Format and manage F2FS, Ext4, exFAT, and FAT32 partitions directly within the app, complete with filesystem checking (fsck).
- Kernel I/O Speed Booster: Automatically tunes sysfs block queue parameters (read-ahead cache buffer up to 2048 KB, I/O schedulers) at boot.
- Universal Root Compatibility: Powered by libsu, working identically across Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch.
📖 Curious about how it works under the hood?
Read our full technical breakdown in Architecture & Internals.

📋 Requirements
- Root Access: Magisk 24+, KernelSU 0.9+, or APatch 10+
- Android OS: Android 10 to Android 16 (API 29–36)
- Storage Media: MicroSD card, External USB-C SSD, or USB OTG drive
- Filesystem: F2FS or Ext4 recommended for native POSIX permissions. exFAT and FAT32 are also supported.

🚀 Quick Start

Choose either of the two hassle-free installation methods:
- Method 1: Universal Module Flash (Recommended)
  1. Download MountX-Magisk-v.zip from GitHub Releases.
  2. Flash the ZIP in Magisk, KernelSU, or APatch. The installer automatically installs the companion MountX app during flash.
  3. Reboot your device, launch MountX from your app drawer, and grant Superuser access.
- Method 2: Standalone APK with In-App Activation
  1. Download and install MountX-v.apk.
  2. Launch the app and grant Superuser permission.
  3. On the Dashboard, tap Install & Activate Module to install the root backend directly without rebooting.

Managing Storage
Open the Apps tab, select your application, tap Manage Storage, choose the data categories to offload (Data, OBB, etc.), select your target external disk and partition, and tap Start Transfer.

📚 Documentation

Detailed guides and manuals are available in the repository and the MountX Wiki:
- Installation Guide : Prerequisites, root setup, and configuration.
- User Guide : Interface overview, partition tools, and storage management.
- Architecture & Internals : Deep technical dive into kernel namespaces, VFS bind-mounts, and I/O tuning.
- FAQ & Troubleshooting : Common questions, crash prevention, and error solutions.
- Contributing Guide : Developer guide, code style, and pull request workflow.
- Changelog : Full release and version history.

❤️ Support the Project

MountX is free and open-source. If it helped you save storage, consider supporting ongoing development:
- ☕ Ko-fi: Support on Ko-fi
- 💳 PayPal: Donate via PayPal
- 💰 Saweria: Dukung via Saweria

📄 License

MountX is licensed under the MIT License.

Developed and maintained by Noir (@Zy0x).
modules.changelog:
Release Notes — MountX v2.2.48

[2.2.48] - 2026-11-04

Added
- Spotify & Private Data Loop Container Engine:
- Implemented sparse virtual ext4/f2fs loop container images (.mountx/containers/_data.img) for large private application storage (/data/data/).
- Added automated SELinux context restoration (u:object_r:app_data_file:s0:c...) and POSIX UID/GID ownership realignment, permanently resolving SQLite and database permission denials for offline music libraries (Spotify) and sensitive app caches.
- Implemented streaming data migration pipeline (tar -c | tar -x) for zero-loss transfer of complex internal directories directly to loop containers without intermediate archive space exhaustion.
- Long backing file paths exceeding 64 characters safely leverage busybox losetup to prevent kernel string truncation.
- Zero-Reboot Silent Module Sync & Live Daemon Reload:
- Introduced seamless root module synchronization on app cold-start (checkAndSyncModuleSilently), copying updated scripts and binaries from APK assets to root storage without requiring Magisk/KernelSU/APatch re-flashing.
- Added graceful daemon termination via /dev/.mountx_service.pid to avoid shell byte-offset corruption during script updates.
- Implemented live daemon reload (nohup sh service.sh &) that immediately adopts updated watchdog supervisor logic while keeping all active mounts intact without requiring a system reboot.
- Added dormant daemon watchdog revival guard to automatically restart the background supervisor if terminated by system memory constraints.

Changed & Improved
- 100% Strict Bilingual Parity (Zero Hardcoded Strings):
- Eliminated all Indonesian text leaks in English system locales across the entire application interface.
- Synchronized values/strings.xml (natural English) and values-id/strings.xml (natural Indonesian) with 1,170 identical translation keys (1:1 parity).
- Cleaned and refactored string resolution across ViewModels, root managers, and Jetpack Compose screens.
- Adaptive I/O Booster Stability across Storage Hardware:
- Refined kernel block queue and read-ahead tuning to strictly target the designated block device BDI (/sys/class/block/$disk/bdi/read_ahead_kb), preventing memory bloat and swap thrashing on zram.
- Added kernel scheduler compatibility verification before applying requested schedulers (such as none, mq-deadline, bfq), preventing kernel write rejections across diverse device kernels.
- Improved queue depth and I/O scheduler presets for budget eMMC 5.1, low/high-class MicroSD (UHS-I, A1/A2), external USB SSDs, and UFS 2.x/3.x/4.0 storage.
- Dynamic Storage Branding & UI Polish:
- Replaced static badges with dynamic hardware titles (e.g. Samsung MicroSD YD4QD, USB, etc.) across donut chart legends and category cards.
- Replaced nested pager swipe in application detail view with responsive segmented capsules ([ Media | Details ]), resolving infinite height measurement crashes....

Install

4. Click reboot

Build

modules.name: Airgap
modules.author: skeler
modules.description: Cut internet access per app. Dedicated iptables chain, resync watchdog, system/user filtering and backup-restore.
modules.readme:
Airgap

Cut internet access per app, on rooted Android. Magisk / KernelSU / APatch module.

Blocked apps are rejected at the kernel level with iptables UID owner matching, so there is
no VPN slot consumed, no battery-draining userspace proxy, and nothing for an app to detect.

Requirements
- Magisk, KernelSU or APatch
- A kernel with xt_owner (-m owner) support — essentially every Android kernel
- KsuWebUI or MMRL for the app picker

Install

Flash airgap-x.y.zip in your root manager and reboot. Open the module's Action / WebUI
entry to pick apps.

WebUI
- Filter by All / User / System / Blocked
- Sort by name, blocked-first, user-first, system-first or UID
- Search, with the full package name and UID on every row
- Export a backup, restore one, or paste backup JSON straight in

Toggles are batched: flipping ten switches issues one rule rebuild, not ten.

CLI

Available as airgap on $PATH under KernelSU and APatch, otherwise at
/data/adb/modules/airgap/system/bin/airgap.

airgap block ...            isolate the given packages
airgap unblock ...|all      restore internet access
airgap set [...|--none]     replace the isolated set with exactly these packages
airgap list                      show isolated packages and their UIDs
airgap status                    show rule, hook and watchdog state
airgap apply                     rebuild and reload all rules
airgap clear                     remove every rule and unhook the chain
airgap backup [file]             write a backup (default: /sdcard/Download)
airgap restore  [--merge]  restore from a backup file
airgap daemon | stop             control the resync watchdog

How it works

Rules live in a dedicated airgap chain hooked once at the head of OUTPUT, loaded atomically
via iptables-restore. Every apply rebuilds that chain from /data/adb/airgap/isolated.json,
which is what keeps the following correct without any bookkeeping:
- Shared UIDs — apps declaring the same sharedUserId share one kernel UID. Unblocking one
  of them keeps the rule as long as another still needs it.
- Reinstalls — an app's UID changes when it is reinstalled. A watchdog watches
  packages.list via inotifyd and re-resolves within seconds, so a stale rule never blocks
  the wrong app.
- netd flushes — Android rebuilds the filter table on VPN, tethering and connectivity
  changes, which silently drops rules placed directly in OUTPUT. A 60s integrity pass
  detects this and repairs the chain.
- Work profiles — secondary-user UIDs (uid + user × 100000) are covered too.

Both IPv4 and IPv6 are handled. REJECT is used where the kernel supports it so blocked apps
fail fast instead of hanging, falling back to DROP otherwise.

Backup & restore

airgap backup                    # -> /sdcard/Download/airgap-YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS.json
airgap restore             # replace the current set
airgap restore  --merge    # add to the current set

Packages in a backup that are not installed are skipped and reported. Restore also accepts a
plain JSON array of package names.

Uninstall

Remove the module in your root manager. This tears down the chain, stops the watchdog and
deletes /data/adb/airgap.

Building

The repository *is* the module — zip its contents with the module files at the archive root,
excluding the repo-only files that the module does not need at runtime:

zip -r9X airgap.zip . -x '.git/*' '.github/*' 'assets/*' 'README.md' 'update.json' 'changelog.md'

Releasing

Root managers poll update.json and offer an update only when its versionCode is higher
than the installed one, so every release must bump it.

1. Bump version and versionCode in module.prop
2. Add the entry to changelog.md
3. Update version, versionCode and zipUrl in update.json to match
4. zip -r9X airgap-.zip . -x '.git/*' '.github/*' 'assets/*' 'README.md' 'update.json' 'changelog.md'
5. gh release create v airgap-.zip --title "Airgap "
6. Push to the default branch — update.json is served from it, so the update only goes
   live once pushed

License

Apache-2.0
modules.changelog:
Per-app internet isolation for Magisk / KernelSU / APatch.

Flash airgap-1.0.zip in your root manager and reboot, then open the module WebUI to pick apps.

Highlights
- Kernel-level blocking — iptables UID owner matching on IPv4 and IPv6. No VPN slot, no userspace proxy.
- Rules that stay applied — a dedicated airgap chain is hooked once at the head of OUTPUT and rebuilt atomically via iptables-restore. A watchdog repairs it after netd flushes the filter table on VPN, tethering or connectivity changes.
- Correct UID handling — shared sharedUserId apps, UID changes after a reinstall (re-resolved within seconds via inotifyd), and work-profile UIDs.
- WebUI — filter by user/system/blocked, six sort modes, search, and batched applies so ten toggles cost one rule rebuild.
- Backup & restore — export to /sdcard/Download, restore or merge, or paste backup JSON directly.

Requirements

Magisk, KernelSU or APatch, plus KsuWebUI or MMRL for the app picker.

modules.name: ChargeMate
modules.author: Yash
modules.description: Limits battery charging between configurable % levels. Edit config.sh to set STOP and START values. Use Action button to reload config instantly without reboot.
modules.readme:
🔋 ChargeMate — Magisk Module

A lightweight Magisk module that automatically limits battery charging between configurable percentage levels, designed to extend long-term battery health. Supports instant config reload via the Action button — no reboot required.

✨ Features
- 🔋 Stops charging at a configurable STOP% (default: 95%)
- 🔄 Resumes charging at a configurable START% (default: 85%)
- ⚡ Action button — reload config instantly without reboot
- 🖥️ Automatically bypasses charging control during USB file transfer, MTP, PTP, or USB tethering
- 🔌 Handles power cuts and charger reconnects gracefully
- 🔁 Supports Magisk in-app updates
- 📝 Simple config file — no app required
- 🪶 Zero UI, zero bloat — pure shell script

📱 Compatibility

| Device Type | Supported |
|---|---|
| MediaTek (MTK) devices | ✅ Yes |
| Redmi Note 9 / Note 8 / Helio G series | ✅ Tested |
| Snapdragon devices | ❌ No (input_suspend node not available) |
| Exynos (Samsung) devices | ❌ No |
| Android 8 – 12 | ✅ Yes |
| Android 13+ | ⚠️ Untested |
Tested on: Redmi Note 9 (Merlin) — Android 10, MIUI 12, Kernel 4.14, Magisk

📦 Installation

1. Download the latest ChargeMate_vX.X.zip from Releases
2. Open Magisk → Modules → Install from storage
3. Select the downloaded zip
4. Reboot your device

⚙️ Configuration

After installation, edit the config file at:

    /data/adb/modules/chargemate/config.sh

Battery % at which charging will pause (50–99)
STOP=95

Battery % at which charging will resume (must be at least 5% below STOP)
START=85

After editing, tap the Action button in Magisk to apply changes instantly — no reboot needed.

Recommended Values

| Use Case | STOP | START |
|---|---|---|
| Daily driver (recommended) | 95 | 85 |
| Maximum battery health | 80 | 70 |
| Overnight charging | 90 | 80 |

▶️ Action Button

Tap the Action button in Magisk → Modules → ChargeMate to:
- Reload config.sh values instantly
- Restart the background service with new limits
- View current battery status, charger state, and active config

No reboot required after config changes.

🔍 How It Works

Boot
    → service.sh starts automatically via Magisk

Charger connected
        ↓
Fresh connection? → Reset input_suspend = 0 (charging enabled)
        ↓
Is USB data / tethering active?
    YES → Skip control, charging continues normally
    NO  ↓
Level >= STOP%  → Pause charging   (input_suspend = 1)
Level <= START% → Resume charging  (input_suspend = 0)

Charger disconnected / power cut
    → Reset input_suspend = 0  (safety reset)
    → Fresh state on reconnect

📂 Module Structure

chargemate/
├── module.prop          # Module metadata
├── service.sh           # Background service (auto-starts on boot)
├── config.sh            # User configuration — edit this file
├── action.sh            # Action button script (instant config reload)
└── META-INF/
    └── com/google/android/
        ├── update-binary
        └── updater-script

❓ FAQ

Q: Charging stopped permanently. How do I fix it?

Disable the module from Magisk → Modules → ChargeMate, then reboot.

Q: Will USB file transfer still work?

Yes. The module monitors the USB state. Whenever a data connection is detected (MTP, PTP, tethering), charging control is automatically bypassed.

Q: Do I need to reboot after editing config.sh?

No. Just tap the Action button in Magisk to reload the config instantly.

Q: How do I verify the script is running?

cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/input_suspend
Output: 1 = charging paused | 0 = charging active

📜 Changelog

v3.1 — Bug Fix
- Fixed critical bug: charging not starting when charger reconnected at 85–95% range
- Improved Action button status — shows IDLE when charger is disconnected
- Added Magisk in-app update support

v3.0
- Added Action button for instant config reload without reboot
- Added config validation with error messages
- Added real-time status display in Action output

v2.0
- Added configurable STOP and START via config.sh
- Added USB data connection detection bypass
- Added charger disconnect safety reset

v1.0
- Initial release

📜 License

MIT License — free to use, modify, and distribute.

🙏 Credits
- Magisk by topjohnwu
- Developed and tested on Redmi Note 9 by Yash

modules.readme:
Enable Blurs for Magisk
This module enables support for window-level blurs on a wide range of devices.

After installing, be sure to go to Settings app -> System -> Developer Options -> Enable Allow window-level blurs under the Hardware accelerated rendering subheading.

Just installing this module isn't enough to get blur/glass effects on your system; system UI components need to specifically be programmed to take advantage of them. One way of achieving this is by installing mods like ClearLineage (download via Telegram), or Iconify.

My module is similar to other modules, but includes a late_start service to modify certain system props just after boot to expand compatibility to a wider range of devices (including my Pixel 5) which don't work with just the standard read-only props mods.

The Action button simply re-runs this late_start service and restarts the surfaceflinger to ensure it takes effect.

Modified Props

	# Default boot stage (system.prop)
	ro.sf.blurs_are_expensive (1)
	ro.surface_flinger.supports_background_blur (1)

	# late_start service boot stage
	persist.sys.sf.disable_blurs (0)

modules.name: FacePass
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: FacePass
modules.readme:
FacePass

English

Use ColorOS face unlock in the system authentication prompt (BiometricPrompt) of the apps you choose.

The ColorOS face sensor reports strength 4095, which belongs to no Android class, so the system lets no third-party app use face. FacePass lets face pass the eligibility check only for the apps you tick, and only when face suits that particular request. Everything else stays stock.

Features
- Whitelist: face appears only in the apps you tick; every other app keeps stock fingerprint.
- Per-request judgment:
- Requests bound to a Keystore key (with a CryptoObject) use fingerprint only. Face is still a weak biometric to the system and cannot unlock such keys.
- If the same app asks again within a few seconds after face succeeded (common with time-bound keys), that request uses fingerprint only. Turning the screen off clears this record.
- Prompt panel: the medium-size ColorOS panel, the same one fingerprint uses. Face and fingerprint start together, and the prompt continues by itself once face succeeds.
- Early face success: if your face is already in front of the camera, the result is held until the prompt has finished appearing, so the system does not take it as a cancellation.
- Fluid Cloud hint: a hint is shown in Fluid Cloud while face recognition runs.
- Lock screen: when the lock screen's own face unlock holds the camera, whitelisted apps can still use face.

How it works

FacePass injects into no app. Its scope is fixed to System Framework and System UI.

| Where | What |
|---|---|
| system_server | Judges each request (face / fingerprint only / stock) and lets face pass the strength check only for requests judged face; handles the camera held by the lock screen and early face success; posts the Fluid Cloud hint |
| SystemUI | Gives whitelisted apps the medium-size panel, removes the needless confirmation, starts fingerprint together with face |

Face images and matching stay in the hardware and the secure environment (TEE). FacePass sees only success or failure.

Security
- Face remains a weak biometric to the system: it unlocks no key that requires strong authentication.
- For apps that only check that authentication succeeded, without a key, whether a photo or video can fool face depends on ColorOS face itself. The risk is the same as with face unlock on the lock screen. Leave banking and payment apps unticked unless you need them.

Requirements
- ColorOS 17 only
- LSPosed with libxposed API 102

Installation

1. Install the APK, enable FacePass in LSPosed, and make sure the scope includes System Framework and System UI.
2. Reboot.
3. Open FacePass and tick the apps that should use face. Allow notifications the first time the Fluid Cloud hint is used.

Troubleshooting: entries tagged FacePass in the LSPosed log show the judgment for each request and, when the system refuses face, the status code.

License

Copyright © 2026 axiom-fn. All rights reserved. No part of this project may be used, copied, modified or distributed without the author's prior written permission. See LICENSE.

繁體中文

讓 ColorOS 的人臉辨識可以用在你指定的應用的系統驗證框（BiometricPrompt）。

ColorOS 的人臉感應器上報的強度是 4095，不屬於 Android 的任何一個等級，系統因此不讓任何第三方應用使用人臉。FacePass 只在你勾選的應用、而且這次驗證適合用人臉時，讓人臉通過資格檢查；其餘一切維持原生。

功能
- 白名單：只有勾選的應用會出現人臉，其他應用保持原生的指紋。
- 逐次判斷：
- 綁定 Keystore 密鑰的驗證（帶 CryptoObject）只用指紋。人臉在系統裡仍是弱認證，解不開這類密鑰。
- 人臉通過後幾秒內同一應用又要求驗證（常見於限時密鑰），那一次只用指紋。關閉螢幕會清除這個紀錄。
- 驗證框：使用 ColorOS 自帶的中尺寸面板（與指紋驗證相同），人臉與指紋同時啟動，人臉通過後自動繼續。
- 人臉過早通過：臉已在鏡頭前時，結果會等驗證框顯示完成才交出，不會被系統當成「取消」。
- 流體雲提示：人臉辨識期間在流體雲顯示「正在尋找你的臉孔」。
- 鎖屏時可用：鎖屏的人臉解鎖佔用鏡頭時，白名單應用的驗證仍可使用人臉。

運作方式

FacePass 不注入任何應用，作用域固定為「系統框架」與「系統介面」。

| 位置 | 做什麼 |
|---|---|
| system_server | 為每個驗證請求作出裁決（人臉／只用指紋／原生），只對裁決為人臉的請求放行人臉的強度檢查；處理鏡頭被鎖屏佔用、人臉過早通過，並發出流體雲提示 |
| SystemUI | 讓白名單應用的驗證框使用中尺寸面板、免去多餘的確認、讓指紋與人臉同時啟動 |

人臉的影像與比對都在硬體與安全環境（TEE）中完成，FacePass 只看得到「成功／失敗」。

安全說明
- 人臉在系統中仍是弱認證：它不會解開任何需要強認證的密鑰。
- 對只檢查「驗證成功」、不使用密鑰的應用，人臉能否被照片或影片騙過，取決於 ColorOS 人臉本身，風險與鎖屏的人臉解鎖相同。銀行與支付類應用如非必要，建議不要勾選。

需求
- 僅支援 ColorOS 17
- 支援 libxposed API 102 的 LSPosed

安裝

1. 安裝 APK，在 LSPosed 中啟用 FacePass，確認作用域包含「系統框架」與「系統介面」。
2. 重新啟動。
3. 開啟 FacePass，勾選要使用人臉的應用；第一次使用流體雲提示時允許通知權限。

疑難排解：LSPosed 日誌中標籤為 FacePass 的紀錄會列出每次請求的裁決，以及人臉被系統拒絕時的原因代碼。

授權

modules.name: Android DNSCrypt-Proxy Module
modules.author: adrianmmiller
modules.description: DNSCrypt-Proxy Magisk Module With Basic Config That Upstreams To Cloudflare + Monitor and Management App
modules.readme:
Android DnsCrypt- Proxy Module

What it is:

An all in one module, with companion app, providing a basic dnscrypt-proxy service for Android

What It ISNT:

A tinfoil hat level dnscrypt-proxy setup with anonymised DNS and 12 relays. I use it for system level ad and domain blocking. May not suit the Graphene and Calyx level tinfoil hatists :)

What It Does:

Features:
- Block ads or unwanted domains (via domain name) at a system level
- Encrypt DNS traffic via upstream DNS resolver (Cloudflare by default)
- Pass all 4 checks (Secure DNS, DNSsec, TLS1.3 and Secure SNI (ECH))  at Cloudflare's Browsing Experience Security Check  with correctly configured device and browsers (module will set prefs for Firefox and Chrome during install)
- An Android app to manage Dnscrypt-proxy, with features:
- Stop/Stop live monitoring of blocked names (via blocked-names.log) with notifications
- Notification of blocked domains via notification shade, or if missed ther,e they can be allowed via Recents tab in app as a backup. the rule can also be removed from blocklist (allow list is always preferable, as the same doman may be re-added via blocklist update, but im giving all options i can think of)
- Each blocked domain is added to a local database, with each blocked domain checked against its has, to make sure you dont see repeat blocked notifications. The also helps when clearing blocked-names.log, you wont see the blocked domains after clearing
- Restart dnscrypt-proxy
- Pause DNS protection - if you need to absolutely access a blocked site without locating and allowing blocked domains - this just stops routing DNS through dnscrypt-proxy, without killing the proxy
- Maintain allowed-names (allowed-names.txt, blocked-names.txt)
- Download, build and maintain your blocklist (blocked-names.txt) from a common repo of multiple blocklist options - you can also add your own blocklist sources. You can also maintain local blocklist via  local-additions (local-additions.txt) to be added on every blocklist rebuild. The Blocklist builder can also update via scheduler
- Settings
- Path to dnscrypt-proxy data files (set to /storage/emulated/0/dnscrypt-proxy by default)
- Dark/Light/System following themes
- 3 button styles

Screenshots of app, app tabs and features, are here

How it works:

Module Install phase
- Module is flashed
- Files are copied to relevant folders
- Usual service/post-fs-data and boot-completed files are copied to module folder
- Basic dnscrypt-proxy config (toml and referenced txt files) are copied to /storage/emulated/0/dnscrypt-proxy ONLY if the path or files in path do not already exist
- Dnscrypt Monitor app is installed and its notification permissions set
- Private DNS is set to Off
- Browsers are configured to use encrypted DNS (Firefox and Chrome are searched for, killed, and their prefs added). Note Chrome should pass 4 ticks out of the box. Firefox can be random/fail on Secure SNI (ECH), but this is a known issue due to handshake and being tracked on a bugid

     Settings added/changed in Firefox (data/data/org.mozilla.firefox/files/mozilla/.default/prefs.js):
         #ECH Settings added by dnscrypt-proxy module
    user_pref("network.dns.echconfig.require_authenticated_dns", false)
    user_pref("network.dns.echconfig.enabled", true)
    user_pref("network.dns.http3_echconfig.enabled", true)
    user_pref("network.dns.force_use_https_rr", true)
    user_pref("network.trr.mode", 0)

     Settings added/changed in Chrome (json)(/data/data/com.android.chrome/app_chrome/Local State):
         dns_over_https":{"mode":"off"}

       Note: Troubleshooting tip if dnscrypt-proxy is running, but ads still apear that should eb blocked, make sure these lines appear in your browser
- Root MUST be granted to Dnscrypt Monitor app before restart for seamless operation on restart
- Reboot completes initial setup

Post reboot
- dnscrypt-proxy is started (service.sh) and uses the TOML config file at /storage/emulated/0/dnscrypt-proxy/dnscrypt-proxy.toml
  Note: Your first troubleshooting point should be to open /storage/emulated/0/dnscrypt-proxy/ and check the dnscrypt-proxy.toml is there, followed by checking dnscrypt-proxy.log to see the status

  service.sh:
     # run dnscrypt-proxy
  while ! [ pgrep -x dnscrypt-proxy ] ; do
	  $MODDIR/system/bin/dnscrypt-proxy -config /storage/emulated/0/dnscrypt-proxy/dnscrypt-proxy.toml && sleep 15;
  done
     dnscrypt-prozy.toml:

    server_names = ['cloudflare']

  listen_addresses = ['127.0.0.1:5354']

  max_clients = 250

  ipv4_servers = true
  ipv6_servers = false
  dnscrypt_servers = true
  doh_servers = true
  odoh_servers = false

  require_dnssec = true
  require_nolog = true
  require_nofilter = true
  disabled_server_names = []

  force_tcp = false
  http3 = false
  http3_probe = false

  timeout = 5000
  keepalive = 30

  log_file = '/storage/emulated/0/dnscrypt-proxy/dnscrypt-proxy.log'
  log_file_latest = true
  log_files_max_size = 10

  cert_refresh_delay = 240

  pqdnscrypt = true

  bootstrap_resolvers = ['1.1.1.1:53', '8.8.8.8:53']

  ignore_system_dns = true

  netprobe_timeout = 60
  netprobe_address = '1.1.1.1:53'

  block_ipv6 = true
  block_unqualified = true
  block_undelegated = true

  reject_ttl = 10

  cache = true
  cache_size = 4096
  cache_min_ttl = 2400
  cache_max_ttl = 86400
  cache_neg_min_ttl = 60
  cache_neg_max_ttl = 600

  [captive_portals]
  map_file = '/storage/emulated/0/dnscrypt-proxy/captive-portals.txt'

  [blocked_names]
  blocked_names_file = '/storage/emulated/0/dnscrypt-proxy/blocked-names.txt'
  log_file = '/storage/emulated/0/dnscrypt-proxy/blocked-names.log'

  [allowed_names]
  allowed_names_file = '/storage/emulated/0/dnscrypt-proxy/allowed-names.txt'

  [sources.public-resolvers]
  urls = [
    'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DNSCrypt/dnscrypt-resolvers/master/v3/public-resolvers.md',
    'https://download.dnscrypt.info/resolvers-list/v3/public-resolvers.md',...

modules.name: HyperSliderGuard
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: HyperSliderGuard
modules.readme:
HyperSliderGuard

简体中文 | English

专为 小米 HyperOS 控制中心 打造的 Xposed/LSPosed 模块，用于禁用亮度条与音量条的长按展开更多选项功能，或分别自定义长按触发时间。

功能特性
- 亮度/音量独立配置：可分别为 亮度条 与 音量条 选择以下模式：
- 禁用长按（默认）：拖动调节亮度或音量时彻底避免误触展开二级面板。
- 自定义长按触发时间：支持 400 ms ~ 3000 ms 调节（步进 50 ms）；上下滑动调节进度超过系统阈值时自动取消长按计时。
- 系统默认：恢复系统原生触发行为（约 400 ms）。
- 静态作用域：基于 Modern Xposed API（META-INF/xposed/scope.list + staticScope=true），启用模块后自动锁定 com.android.systemui。
- 配置热生效：通过 RemotePreferences 跨进程同步配置，修改设置后无需重启系统界面即可生效。
- 隐藏桌面图标：支持隐藏桌面启动器图标，隐藏后仍可从 LSPosed 模块列表点击进入设置页。
- 一键复制诊断日志：内置设备信息、模块状态、配置快照与本进程 Logcat 收集，方便反馈排查。

已测试环境与版本

| 项目 | 已验证版本 |
| --- | --- |
| 模块版本 | 1.0.0 (versionCode: 100) |
| 测试机型 | Xiaomi 14 (houji / 23127PN0CC) |
| Android 版本 | Android 16 (API 36) |
| 系统版本 | HyperOS 3.0 (OS3.0.307.0.WNCCNXM) |
| 框架环境 | LSPosed v2.2.1 (7912) |
| 模块 API | LibXposed API 102.0.0（保留 Legacy Xposed API 82 兼容兜底） |
| 宿主插件 | miui.systemui.plugin（由 com.android.systemui 动态加载） |

使用方法

1. 安装 HyperSliderGuard APK。
2. 打开 LSPosed 管理器 -> 模块 -> 启用 HyperSliderGuard（静态作用域已自动锁定 系统界面 com.android.systemui）。
3. 首次启用后在 LSPosed 中重启一次 系统界面。
4. 从桌面或 LSPosed 模块设置进入 HyperSliderGuard，修改配置后立即生效。

实现原理

1. 在 com.android.systemui 中 Hook BaseDexClassLoader 构造函数，捕获动态加载的 miui.systemui.plugin 插件 ClassLoader。
2. Hook BrightnessSliderController 与 VolumeSliderController 的 onBindViewHolder / setListening，通过 getSlider() 分别标记亮度与音量 VerticalSeekBar 实例。
3. 在 ViewTouchAnim$gestureListener$1.onLongPress 拦截原生 400 ms 长按（禁用模式下同时在 View.performLongClick 兜底）。
4. 自定义时长模式下，在 ViewTouchAnim.onTouchEvent 使用主线程 Handler.postDelayed 计时，并基于 rawX / rawY 位移判断是否取消，避免滑动调节时误触发。

构建说明
- JDK：Java 17+
- Android Gradle Plugin：9.5.2（Built-in Kotlin）
- Gradle：9.9.1
- compileSdk：37，minSdk：31，targetSdk：37

gradle assembleDebug

问题反馈与日志收集

如果在新版系统或其它机型上出现未生效，或需要增加适配版本，请一并附上以下内容：
1. 模块诊断日志：在 HyperSliderGuard 设置页点击 「复制日志」 获取设备信息与配置诊断报告。
2. 宿主侧 Hook 日志：在 LSPosed 管理器 -> 日志 页面筛选标签 HyperSliderGuard，导出系统界面（com.android.systemui）宿主侧日志。
3. 当前版本的宿主 APK：提供你当前系统版本对应的宿主 APK（miui.systemui.plugin 及/或 com.android.systemui / MiuiSystemUI.apk）。

modules.readme:
Sport Editor / 运动修改器

基于 libxposed（LSPosed 现代 Xposed API）的步数修改模块，Kotlin + Jetpack Compose 编写。可为微信、支付宝、QQ、微博分别设置步数的修改方式、数值与每日上限。

功能
- 默认关闭，手动启用：只修改已打开开关且在框架作用域内的应用
- 每个应用独立配置：开关、修改方式（倍率 / 增加 / 自动 / 固定）、数值、每日上限互不影响
- 每日上限：按本地日期重置，跨天不冻结
- 实时同步：设置改动即时下发到目标应用，无需重启
- 界面：Material 3 Expressive，支持深色模式、动态取色（Android 12+）与中英文切换
- 诊断页：环境快照、配置与 Hook 日志，便于排查

要求
- Android 8.0（API 26）及以上
- LSPosed / Vector 等支持 libxposed API 102 的框架
- 模块作用域已内置微信（com.tencent.mm）、支付宝（com.eg.android.AlipayGphone）、QQ（com.tencent.mobileqq）、微博（com.sina.weibo）

使用

1. 安装后在框架中启用模块，确认作用域包含目标应用
2. 强制停止目标应用（或重启手机）使其加载模块
3. 打开本应用，为要修改的应用打开开关并设置方式与数值
4. 重新打开目标应用查看步数

链接
- 源码与问题反馈：https://github.com/gythialy/SportEditor
- 许可证：MIT
仅供学习与测试，自负风险。

SpotXero

An Xposed module for Spotify on Android

1. Download SpotXero
- Obtainium (Recommended): Automatically track and install updates by adding SpotXero to Obtainium:

Or enter the repository URL manually:

https://github.com/s1ddhants1/spotxero

modules.name: NexFusion

modules.description: NexFusion
modules.readme:
NexFusion

NexFusion is an open-source runtime patch manager and LSPosed framework featuring a clean Material You interface. It applies in-memory bytecode hooks dynamically using libxposed and DexKit to popular Android applications without modifying the original APKs, breaking Play Store signatures, or losing official update paths.

What Makes NexFusion Different?

Unlike traditional patching tools that require compiling and repacking modified APKs:
- Zero APK Repacking: Modifies bytecode purely in RAM at app startup via LSPosed. Original apps stay untouched and can be updated normally through Google Play.
- Modular Patch Bundles (.nxb): Patches and hooks are distributed as lightweight, independently updatable bundles. Update patch features without reinstalling the manager app.
- Dynamic Target Discovery: Only targets applications supported by your installed patch bundles—no hardcoded app clutter.
- Automatic Background Updates: Optionally checks for and installs patch bundle updates in the background for a seamless set-it-and-forget-it experience.
- Built-in Stealth Cloak: Shields target apps from detecting root or Xposed module presence.

Supported Applications Matrix

NexFusion pairs with the official NexFusion Unified Patches bundle (a092devs/Nexfusion-Patches) to enhance 17+ supported application targets:

modules.name: StageLab Native
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: StageLab Native
modules.readme:
StageLab Native（原生台前调度）
  面向 Android 13–17 平板与折叠屏的原生级 iPad Stage Manager LSPosed 模块

StageLab Native 基于系统原生 ShellTaskOrganizer、WindowContainerTransaction 与 ColorOS 原生浮窗引擎（Flexible Window），在 Android 13–17 平板及折叠屏设备上提供原生级 120fps 台前调度（Stage Manager） 体验——所有应用窗口均为真实系统任务窗口，非录屏镜像、非 WebView 模拟、非无障碍伪装。

本模块需要 Root（Magisk / KernelSU）与 LSPosed / Vector 环境，推荐启用作用域：system、com.android.systemui、com.android.launcher。关闭台前调度开关时所有系统 Hook 门控同步归零退出，无残余窗口或手势拦截。

效果展示

| 控制面板与诊断页 | 横屏多窗平铺与左侧 3D 工作区栏 | 120fps 物理弹簧应用搜索 |
|---|---|---|
|  |  |  |

核心特性
- 原生多窗口工作区（Stage）与自由平铺：横屏 2～3 窗自动等宽并排，竖屏自动转为全宽上下堆叠行；支持旋转屏幕实时尺寸自适应与横竖屏独立窗口记忆，以及每工作区独立的侧边迷你悬浮窗（FloatHandle）。
- 左侧 3D 最近工作区栏 & 120fps 神奇移动过渡：实时拉取系统 TaskSnapshotManager / ActivityTaskManager 高清缩略图（自动避让 FLAG_SECURE 隐私窗口），点击切换工作区、向内拖拽合并入当前工作台。
- 底部毛玻璃 Dock 与零延迟物理弹簧应用搜索（⌕）：预暖常驻窗口支持任意毫秒点击遮罩/Dock 打断动画；长按搜索卡片或直接从 Dock 图标自由拖拽至 Dock 指定槽位让位固定、水平排序、拖动取消固定，以及拖放合并入当前工作区或左侧 3D 工作区卡片。
- 多设备多版本兼容性：支持 ColorOS 13–17 / OxygenOS / realme UI 原生浮窗路径，并在 AOSP 环境自动回退至标准 WindowContainerTransaction#setBounds + WINDOWING_MODE_FREEFORM；内置实时探针诊断面板（OPPO Pad mini / ColorOS V17.0.0 / Android 17 实测通过）。

安装与作用域

1. 下载并安装最新版 APK（StageLab-Native-.apk）。
2. 在 LSPosed / Vector 中启用 StageLab Native (io.github.luckylca.stagelab)，确认作用域包含：
- system（系统框架）
- com.android.systemui（系统界面）
- com.android.launcher（系统桌面）
3. 重启或软重启一次设备后，打开 StageLab Native 开启 启用台前调度 开关即可体验。

更多说明、构建指南与紧急恢复命令行见源码仓库：luckylca/pad-stage-manager。

modules.name: TG快点滑
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: TG快点滑
modules.readme:
TG快点滑

Telegram Android 官方客户端的相册查看器加速模块。在聊天里直接点开任意位置的图片或视频，约 0.3 秒即可左右滑动，不再逐页等待。
LSPosed module for the official Telegram Android client. Opens any photo/video in a chat and makes it swipeable in ~0.3s, instead of paging through the whole history.

包名：io.github.dunxuan.tgfastviewer · 作用域：org.telegram.messenger · 需要 LSPosed 2.2+（libxposed API 101）

问题

在聊天里点开一张媒体时，Telegram 不看这张媒体在哪，而是先取"最新 20 张"，发现没有就开始一页 40 张地往更旧方向顺序翻页。越旧、媒体越多，往返次数越多——百万级消息的频道意味着上千次请求，列表和计数迟迟不出现，甚至永远不出来。

做法

1. 就地取窗口：拦下首次列表加载，改为对该媒体发一次 messages.search（offset_id=锚点、add_offset=-(50/2+1)、limit=50），一次拿到锚点前后连续 50 条，交给客户端自己的 processLoadedMedia 处理——填表、排序、缩略图、通知全部沿用原逻辑。
2. 计数只在精确时显示：窗口落地后并行发一个 limit=1 探针取该会话最新媒体 id，只有它等于窗口顶部才显示 n/m；否则跳过计数控件的 onDraw，宁可不显示，也不显示会跳变的值。滑动不被探针阻塞。
3. 失败回退：请求失败或为空时，用 Invoker.Type.ORIGIN 原样调用被拦下的方法，行为回到官方原状。

兼容性

模块不依赖任何被混淆的方法名，全部靠运行时发现：

| 目标 | 找法 |
|---|---|
| PhotoViewer.didReceivedNotification | 按名字 hook（接口实现，名字保留） |
| 媒体控制器（官方包里已被 R8 改名） | hook ConnectionsManager.sendRequest（6 个重载），从调用栈取类，按方法形状匹配 |
| loadMedia / processLoadedMedia | 按参数类型顺序匹配，不看名字；11/12 参都收 |
| 计数控件 | PhotoViewer 内嵌 View 子类 + 签名形状双路探测 |

两个拦截点同时生效（loadMedia 与投递口 processLoadedMedia），因为部分构建里前者会被 R8 内联。

已对上游 TelegramMessenger/Telegram-Android 近两年 20 个版本（11.4.2 → 13.2.1）的 MediaDataController.java 做过逐字节签名比对：loadMedia（11 参）与 processLoadedMedia（12 参）签名两年零漂移，mediaDidLoad 通知参数顺序也完全一致。13.3.1 实测可用（Play 商店全混淆包）。

生效范围：聊天/频道里直接点开单张图片或视频（含评论帖，可连续滑进相邻评论帖）。

不介入：资料页媒体页、相册多选、私密聊天、搜索/过滤、定时消息、群升级旧段、网页内嵌媒体——这些场景行为与官方完全一致。

抓不到类或方法时模块静默不介入，不会影响 Telegram 正常运行；日志里 cand ... shapes= 行可用于排查新版本。

安装

adb install -r TgFastViewer-1.3.0.apk

然后在 LSPosed 中启用并勾选作用域 Telegram（org.telegram.messenger），强停 Telegram 重新打开。

模块不带界面（无 Activity、无启动图标），只作为 hook 载体。如需命令行操作：

su -c '/data/adb/modules/zygisk_lsposed/lspctl module enable --user=0 io.github.dunxuan.tgfastviewer'
su -c '/data/adb/modules/zygisk_lsposed/lspctl scope add --user=0 io.github.dunxuan.tgfastviewer org.telegram.messenger'

日志 tag TgFastViewer，正常会看到 network hooks: 6、hooks ready，以及每次打开媒体的 around / window size / delivered。

构建

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\build-local.ps1

流程：javac（android.jar + libs/libxposed-api-102.0.0.jar）→ d8 → tools/make_apk.py 生成二进制 AndroidManifest.xml 并打包 → apksigner 签名。

依赖 io.github.libxposed:api:102.0.0（compileOnly），minApiVersion=101、targetApiVersion=101、staticScope=true。工程也可直接用 Android Studio 打开（AGP 8.13.2 / compileSdk 36 / minSdk 23）。
本机 aapt2 link 无法创建归档，所以 tools/make_apk.py 自行生成二进制清单，不依赖 aapt2。

已知限制
- 每次打开仍需一次网络往返（实测 0.25~0.30s）；模块拿不到客户端本地媒体索引，断网时没有可滑邻居，与官方一致。
- 计数在"窗口未顶到最新"时一律隐藏：客户端 API 不提供任意锚点的精确位置。
- 签名密钥 module.keystore 不入库（口令见 build-local.ps1），发布前需自行备份，否则无法发布可覆盖升级的更新。

License

MIT
